name: influencer.tag_set
description: Records one answer of the model for a person: its tags, each spelled as influencer.tag_add spells them, kept only if valid, never one the team removed or added, at most six, and the source it tagged from (influencer.tag_due). Null tags: the model did not answer well; nothing changes but the time of the try. Internal. A person who edited while the model answered (the source is no longer theirs) keeps the last try's time, so they are due again at once.
sql:
update brandbase.influencers i set
  tags_ai = case when :tags::jsonb is null then i.tags_ai else coalesce((select array_agg(k.t order by k.n) from (select d.t, d.n from (select distinct on (brandbase.tag_of(e.v)) brandbase.tag_of(e.v) as t, e.n from jsonb_array_elements_text(:tags::jsonb) with ordinality as e (v, n) order by brandbase.tag_of(e.v), e.n) d where brandbase.tag_ok(d.t) and d.t <> all (i.tags_hidden) and d.t <> all (i.tags_team) order by d.n limit 6) k), '{}') end,
  tags_source = case when :tags::jsonb is null then i.tags_source else :source::text end,
  tagged_at = case when brandbase.influencer_tag_source(i.category, i.notes, i.bio) = :source::text then :now::timestamptz else i.tagged_at end
where i.id = :id::uuid
returning jsonb_build_object('id', i.id, 'tags', brandbase.influencer_tags(i.tags_team, i.tags_ai)) as result
